title: 無刷直流馬達驅動器
summary: 以 4 階段、24 步探討六步換相、反電勢偵測與電流控制，包含 12 個專題模型、對照驗證、原創教學算例及延伸工法。
summaryEn: Four stages and 24 steps explore six-step commutation, back-EMF sensing and current regulation, including 12 topic-specific models, controlled checks, original worked examples and related methods.
scope: 公開原理支持的離線工程教學；24 步是學習拆解，不是完整工廠或現場 SOP。數字明示為假設教學例，不冒充廠商機密、實測或通用設定。電路操作限於模擬；六步控制不適合用作所有 PMSM 的通用性能保證，電機波形與熱限制須匹配。
scopeEn: Offline engineering education based on public principles. The 24 steps are a learning decomposition, not a complete factory/field SOP. Numbers are explicit teaching assumptions, not proprietary recipes, measurements or universal settings. Circuit work is simulation-only; six-step control is not a universal performance guarantee for all PMSMs, and waveform/thermal compatibility must be checked.

stages.title: 電機與橋臂
stages.description: 以三個具體技術單元完成電機與橋臂；每單元先建立模型，再以對照和反證驗收。
stages.descriptionEn: Complete motor and bridge through three technical units, each pairing a model with controlled verification.

steps.title: 辨識梯形反電勢：建立模型

steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解辨識梯形反電勢，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand identify trapezoidal back-emf through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 將理想梯形與供應商公開波形對照，標出圓角和諧波。 先畫出系統邊界與能量或訊號方向，逐項寫明單位、定義和固定條件，再預測結果；只使用離線模型或已取得的公開紀錄。
steps.instructionEn: Compare ideal trapezoidal and published waveforms and mark rounded edges/harmonics. First draw the system boundary and energy/signal direction. State units, definitions and controlled conditions, then predict the result. Use offline models or already available public records only.
steps.observation: 將理想梯形與供應商公開波形對照，標出圓角和諧波。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Compare ideal trapezoidal and published waveforms and mark rounded edges/harmonics. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：四極對馬達轉速 3,000 rpm，電頻率 fe=pn/60=200 Hz。一電週六個換相區間，因此換相事件率 1,200 次/s，每區約 0.833 ms。PWM 頻率與換相頻率是不同變數。 電路操作限於模擬；六步控制不適合用作所有 PMSM 的通用性能保證，電機波形與熱限制須匹配。

PWM frequency and commutation frequency are different variables. Circuit work is simulation-only; six-step control is not a universal performance guarantee for all PMSMs, and waveform/thermal compatibility must be checked.

knowledge.title: 建立電機電角度：原理
knowledge.text: 機械圈數與電週數相差極對數，霍爾區間需以電角度理解。
knowledge.textEn: Mechanical turns and electrical cycles differ by pole pairs; Hall sectors use electrical angle.

knowledge.title: 建立電機電角度：證據
knowledge.text: 重算本課 200 Hz 與 0.833 ms，檢查與 PWM 周期不同。
knowledge.textEn: Recompute 200 Hz and 0.833 ms and distinguish them from PWM periods.

knowledge.title: 本課可重算的算例與適用範圍
knowledge.text: 教學例：四極對馬達轉速 3,000 rpm，電頻率 fe=pn/60=200 Hz。一電週六個換相區間，因此換相事件率 1,200 次/s，每區約 0.833 ms。PWM 頻率與換相頻率是不同變數。 電路操作限於模擬；六步控制不適合用作所有 PMSM 的通用性能保證，電機波形與熱限制須匹配。
knowledge.textEn: Teaching example: four pole pairs at 3,000 rpm give fe=pn/60=200 Hz. Six sectors per electrical cycle imply 1,200 commutations/s and about 0.833 ms per sector. PWM frequency and commutation frequency are different variables. Circuit work is simulation-only; six-step control is not a universal performance guarantee for all PMSMs, and waveform/thermal compatibility must be checked.

quiz.questionEn: For “Establish electrical angle: build the model”, which claim or verification is justified?
options: 只要數值接近名目值，就不必檢查單位、量測邊界與誤差。
以其他課程或其他元件的額定值直接作本步的驗收門檻。
機械圈數與電週數相差極對數，霍爾區間需以電角度理解。
optionsEn: If a number is near its nominal value, units, boundaries and errors do not need checking.
Use a rating from another course or device directly as this step’s acceptance limit.
Mechanical turns and electrical cycles differ by pole pairs; Hall sectors use electrical angle.
quiz.explanation: 機械圈數與電週數相差極對數，霍爾區間需以電角度理解。 重算本課 200 Hz 與 0.833 ms，檢查與 PWM 周期不同。
quiz.explanationEn: Mechanical turns and electrical cycles differ by pole pairs; Hall sectors use electrical angle. Recompute 200 Hz and 0.833 ms and distinguish them from PWM periods.

steps.title: 建立電機電角度：反證與驗收
steps.titleEn: Establish electrical angle: challenge and acceptance
steps.objective: 以可檢驗證據理解建立電機電角度，辨識物理機制、量測條件與模型限制。
steps.objectiveEn: Understand establish electrical angle through testable evidence, distinguishing physics, measurement conditions and model limits.
steps.instruction: 先沿用模型，寫下會推翻「機械圈數與電週數相差極對數，霍爾區間需以電角度理解。」的觀察。重算本課 200 Hz 與 0.833 ms，檢查與 PWM 周期不同。 加入一個對照條件，分開記錄原始數據、推論與不確定度；若前提失效則暫緩判定。
steps.instructionEn: Use the model and state an observation that would refute this claim: Mechanical turns and electrical cycles differ by pole pairs; Hall sectors use electrical angle. Recompute 200 Hz and 0.833 ms and distinguish them from PWM periods. Add a control condition and separate raw data, inference and uncertainty. Withhold acceptance if assumptions fail.
steps.observation: 重算本課 200 Hz 與 0.833 ms，檢查與 PWM 周期不同。 比較前先確認量綱與取樣時間一致；若差異小於不確定度，保留未定結論。
steps.observationEn: Recompute 200 Hz and 0.833 ms and distinguish them from PWM periods. Match dimensions and sampling time before comparison; retain an unresolved conclusion if differences are below uncertainty.
steps.failure: 若「建立電機電角度」的結果與預測不符，分別檢查定義／尺度、模型前提及感測或數據錯誤；不要把六步換相、反電勢偵測與電流控制的限制隱藏在單一合格數字中。
steps.failureEn: If establish electrical angle disagrees with prediction, separately check definitions/scaling, assumptions and sensing/data faults. Do not hide the limits of six-step commutation, back-EMF sensing and current regulation behind one passing number.
steps.check: 交付「建立電機電角度」的圖或計算、預測、指定對照、單位與一項尚未驗證的假設；說明何種觀察應暫緩放行。
steps.checkEn: Submit a diagram/calculation for establish electrical angle, prediction, specified comparison, units and one unvalidated assumption. State which observation requires withholding acceptance.
